rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a professional cook, including a restaurant's head chef.

example.english: The chef at this restaurant cooks to a high standard.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅廚師煮嘅菜好有水準。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ceoi4 si1 zyu2 ge3 coi3 hou2 jau5 seoi2 zeon2

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the chef is the head or senior cook.

example.english: This hotel hired a head chef to run the kitchen.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店請咗個大廚返嚟掌廚。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 cing2 zo2 go3 daai6 cyu2 faan1 lei4 zoeng2 ceoi4
